description:
Goal: make the unified fixtures2 behavioral matrix an honest, green statement of current language behavior. The original 119-failure observation is historical; most buckets were resolved or split. Current direct audit finds four deferred fixtures (11 path deferrals): enumerable_protocol_dispatch remains blocked by fz-bv3; enum_tier0 and fz_f98_map_reduce remain blocked by fz-f98; enum_map_family's old fz-9i4.7.3 direct-target defect is fixed but two newly minimized native defects now block re-enablement (fz-9i4.7.10/.11).

The non-deferred debug matrix currently has a broad diagnostics-golden class tracked by fz-lfp; do not blindly bless warnings, weaken the empty-diagnostics contract, or add wildcard clauses without reviewing each fixture's intended language behavior. fz-go4.22 owns the remaining cross-epic matrix-red census. This umbrella closes only when those current blockers are resolved, all stale defers are removed, the single-threaded matrix is green, resource invalid-field behavior is source-diagnostic rather than a host abort, and the proven coverage floor is restored.

Current leaf work under this ticket: fz-9i4.7.5.1, .7.8, .7.10, and .7.11. External blockers are explicit DAG dependencies so the ready frontier remains truthful.

comments.text:
Re-triaged the broad matrix red on fz-go4.1/frontdoor-cli-ownership; down to 64 fixture-matrix failures. Bucketed by cause (each maps to an existing ticket except the last):

- 17x 'unresolved multi-target direct callsite; dispatch must be settled upstream' (membership_operator, map_enumerable, range_enumerable, enumerable_protocol_dispatch, enum_take_drop_split, ...) — dispatch not settled. Same-arity tuple slice is fz-9i4.5.
- 5x 'matched multiple published boundaries' + 2x 'verify main' — callable boundary materialization; overlaps fz-hwn.13.
- 5x 'lower/unbound' (keyword_lists, ...).
- 4x 'ReturnLanes arity mismatch' (no_parens_do, no_parens_keyword, map_enumerable AOT).
- ~5x drive-limit / 3s timeouts (enum_tier0, enum_map_family) — overlaps fz-hwn.9.
- Golden-only / allocation-contract mismatches: see fz-rh2.16.2 (append/filter/reverse/quicksort now resolved there).

UNCOVERED bucket needing a dedicated ticket:
- 3x spec_violation 'expected diagnostic (nonzero exit) but the program succeeded', plus tree losing type/no-matching-clause and case_tuple_pattern_sequential losing case_clause fall-through. These are LOST exhaustiveness/spec diagnostics — a regression of the closed fz-rh2.11.8. Verified pre-existing vs parent commit ca703c6b7 (independent of the cons-reuse work). No open ticket covers this; recommend filing one.

title: Finish the honest fixtures2 matrix after reclassifying current failures
